# Core Rule 10 - Factions
## General Faction Rules
Factions at war are allowed to shoot each other on sight outside of [color=#008000]Green Zones[/color]. Some factions are locked in perpetual war and will never change; the same applies for some alliances. Other wars and alliances are determined by faction leaders. Note: All factions are at war with [textlink="Monolith" link="RuleF4"].
Faction members should not hand out exclusive faction gear without permission from the faction lead. This is especially true for factions that spawn with free kits like the Military and Monolith. Faction members should also not let non-faction members see or use their shops without permission from their leader.
When traveling in a group, if a member of your group is of a different faction and is being shot at by a member of one of their rival factions, you are allowed to assist your group member if you wish.
Factions are required to roleplay as the faction they are playing. The leader must ensure that recruits have at least a basic understanding of the faction's lore and playstyle. This is to maintain an interactive experience.
Faction leaders are held to a higher standard of roleplay and should maintain their faction's rules and check on their subordinates.
When leaving or changing factions, staff must be notified through ahelp or discord tickets. Failure to do so may result in a stash wipe.
If your faction is not listed here, then you have no specific faction rules or perpetual wars/alliances and should follow your leader's rules. You should also follow your leader's rules even if you have rules here. Leader rules should not overwrite faction rules.
* Information on faction tabs is not for in-character knowledge — this is OOC knowledge for a better understanding of expected gameplay. *
## Trading
Factions leaders may choose what they wish to trade with a few restrictions: - Factions may not directly trade with any faction at [color=#FF0000]war[/color] or [color=##FFA500]hostile[/color] with them except for the purposes of relation changing diplomatic agreements. - Faction exclusive weapons, armor, or helms may only be sold or traded to allied factions or as an appropriate award for prospective new members. - Any equipment or weapons from free kits for the Military may not be traded for any reason. - Loners may trade with hostile factions, but cannot trade for faction exclusive weapons, armor, or helms from any faction.
## Alliances and Wars
Faction relations can be changed by faction leaders at Igor. Relationship changes should be preceeded by appropriate roleplay, faction leaders found to be abusing the system will face administrative action.
Faction leaders should agree to rules of war and post their agreements in their respective faction discords as soon as possible upon starting any war. Gear looting agreements will be enforced by administration.
## Faction Relation RP
- [color=#008000]Allies[/color] or [color=##FFFF00]neutral[/color] factions can always be allowed within a faction base and may be treated in RP per individual relationships - [color=##FFA500]Hostile[/color] factions should not be allowed within a faction base unless for the purposes of diplomacy and should always be treated with a level of wariness where possible, even if personal relations would dictate individual characters have a better relationship. Prisoners may be treated on an individual basis. If you believe unexpected circumstances waarant cooperation you may ahelp for approval. - [color=#FF0000]Warring[/color] factions should never be allowed within a base except by an announced diplomatic meeting between leaders ahead of time. In all circumstances any member of a warring faction should be fought, captured, or avoided entirely. In [color=#008000]green zones[/color] factions at [color=#FF0000]war[/color] should be treated with at minimum mistrust. Prisoners may again be treated on an invidual basis.
